frame: F1, mm: +x forward (bill tip ~+169), +y wearer's left, +z up (01_frame)

conventions.uAxis: reads left-to-right as seen from outside the hat; for the label, as seen by someone inside the hat looking at the band
conventions.vAxis: up (toward the crown with the hat worn)
conventions.normal: the visible face's normal (outward for the crown areas, into the hat for the label) = u x v
conventions.area: die_no6.json zones[].area is where a logo may sit (die px); capMm / capIn (= maxImprint) bound its size. front / left / right / back: centre, normal, uAxis, vAxis are the HOME centre (where a new logo goes, the cap rect home.rectMm about it), where the chart is true size and chartToDie's origin; sizeMm / sizeIn the area's bounding box in the chart, areaRectMm its [u0, u1, v0, v1] about the centre; outline3d / holes3d the area on the fabric; marginsMm hold on the model (3-D distance from the area to the region's seam / bottom / button / binding boundary and from each eyelet's 3-D ring centre for the keep-out). areaSqIn is the chart's (the die's), areaSurfaceSqIn the model's.
conventions.printUv: u = x/W, v = 1 - y/H on TEXCOORD_0 (die-stage pixels x right, y down)
conventions.trueScale: area zones: the area-weighted scale within 15 mm of the home centre = 1; label: the area-weighted median
conventions.eyelets: the keep-outs use the eyelets where they are on this state; 06 re-stamps them as mirrored pairs, so they move when 05z re-runs after 06
conventions.level: zones[].level (and die_no6.json zones[].level): the spot's LEVEL for the storefront's SPOT_LEVELS (PR #245): the die rotation in whole degrees, clockwise as the designer stores rotation (die x right, y down), at which art runs parallel to the hat's bottom edge there. The charts stay upright at the home centre (v = world up projected there); the level compensates. levelFit: the measured angle and the line's fit (sides: the panel's bottom edge from the back seam to where it turns up into the bill; front: the bill crease within the cap's half width of the centre line; back: the arch top's level line within the cap's half width of seam B; label: the band's bottom fold across the card); panel_centre_up_tilt_deg: world-up at the panel's own centre seen in the chart (0 = upright there too)

levelFit.what: the bill crease (the panel's bottom edge) within the cap's half width of the centre line: the tilt at the centre line (quadratic fit)

patch.method: 05z (No. 6): the step-04 proxy carried onto detail, the region's faces, 10 normal-only Taubin passes, LSCM + 30 ARAP iterations, true size at the home centre (radius 15 mm); full-res vertices by their proxy triangle's barycentrics

levelFit.what: the panel's bottom edge from the back seam to where it turns up into the bill

levelFit.what: the floor (the arch top's level line, z 68.73) within the cap's half width of seam B: the tilt at seam B (quadratic fit)

floor.rule: above the plane through the arch binding's outer top edge (the top of the snap opening)
